node.title: Rate-half residual prime-field collapse
node.statement: At either unresolved rate-half budget B in {2^39,2^39+1}, every admissible field order q=p^f with 2^41 dividing q-1 has f=1. LTE first forces f in {1,2,3,4}. Exact intersection of the two narrow budget intervals with the complete roots of x^f=1 modulo 2^41 leaves 46 quadratic candidates and no cubic or quartic candidates; a printed divisor ledger proves all 46 quadratic candidates composite. Hence every residual shard is over a prime field of characteristic greater than 2^167.
